instruction.text: Select all the fungi in the picture.

feedback.finish: Fungi are decomposers. This means they turn dead plants and animals into soil or dirt.
feedback.wrong: Not quite. That’s a type of bacteria!

instruction.text: Select the three types of bacteria on the image.

feedback.finish: Bacteria are also decomposers. In just one handful of dirt, there are millions of bacteria! Although you can see them in this image, you would need a microscope to see them in real life.

hint.text: Detritivores are animals that feed on dead material.

feedback.finish: Millipedes, earthworms and snails are all detritivores. They feed on dead material.

atoms.b: Decomposers play an important role in ((++breaking_down producing)) dead plants and animals. Some decomposers are ((++fungi sunshine)), bacteria and detritivores.

Without decomposers, ((++plants the_Sun)) would miss lots of important nutrients and minerals. Without these nutrients, the plants couldn’t grow at all. This could damage the ((++food_web sky)) and allow it to collapse.

instruction.text: Listen and select the correct answer.

atoms.a: What do you think will happen to this fallen tree?

b.sound: fungi and bacteria will begin decomposing it
the tree will continue growing on its side as normal

atoms.a: What do you think the soil is given in the process of decomposing?
